tagline: Turn any idea into viral 9:16 reels with Hormozi subtitles in 10 seconds
short_description_50_words: OmniViral AI is the all-in-one AI video engine and 20-agent autonomous content factory. Turn any prompt or topic into viral 9:16 Shorts with retention-tested hooks, Veo 3/Kling prompts, kinetic Hormozi subtitles, and automated multi-platform social scheduling.
full_description_250_words: OmniViral AI solves the biggest bottleneck for modern digital creators, agency founders, and faceless channel owners: the hours spent brainstorming hooks, writing scripts, formatting subtitles, and scheduling content. With OmniViral AI, simply enter any topic or niche. In less than 10 seconds, our AI generates 3 psychology-backed viral hooks (94%+ retention score), complete 9:16 visual storyboards with exact prompts for Google Veo 3 and Kling 1.5, and generates dynamic Alex Hormozi-style karaoke subtitles with glowing neon power-word highlights. Furthermore, OmniViral includes a 20-agent autonomous swarm that scouts breakout trends, produces daily video packs, and auto-dispatches posts across YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok via free Postiz integration.
